subject.title: Feature: allow account switching from /models buttons for GPT and Claude

question: Should `/models` grow a first-class cross-channel account/profile selector for provider-backed models, and what shared contract should Discord, Telegram, and future channel pickers implement?
rationale: The lower-level auth-profile machinery exists, but the user-visible picker behavior, persistence semantics, compatibility with typed `/model ...@profile`, and per-channel UI shape need maintainer product direction.

options.title: Define Shared Picker Contract
options.body: Add one shared account/profile picker model consumed by supported channel pickers, including compatible profile lists and active-profile display.

options.title: Keep Typed Commands Only
options.body: Decide that `/model ...@profile`, `/model status`, and auth-order commands remain the supported account-switching path and defer or close picker UX work.

options.title: Pilot One Channel First
options.body: Approve a narrower experiment in one channel while documenting that other channel pickers stay unchanged until the shared contract is accepted.

recommendation.title: Define Shared Picker Contract
recommendation.body: Add one shared account/profile picker model consumed by supported channel pickers, including compatible profile lists and active-profile display.

likelyOwner.reason: The clearest history signal is shared model override auth handling plus adjacent plugin/channel refactor ownership.
